about_the_game:
"Seven Days on the Edge: Galactic Fringe" is a sci-fi suspense text-based adventure (AVG) game that blends light survival mechanics with a multi-branch narrative system. In a web of intertwined fates, every choice you make could determine life or death for others—and ultimately, shape your own ending.

Story Introduction
An unexpected malfunction in the Galactic Union Public Rail forces a train to make an emergency stop at Ferron Station. Ferron — notorious as one of the few gray zones within the Galactic Union where organ trading, cloning experiments, and human modification are fully legalized.

Survival is your only priority. With this determination, you find yourself trapped in the dangers of Ferron. To stay alive and escape, you will need wisdom and careful choices, gradually uncovering the truth behind the railway malfunction…

Key Features

  • Story-driven survival management: Each day, you must balance exploration, resource gathering, and relationship building while wisely allocating limited action points.

  • Choice-driven, multiple endings: Every decision can affect character relationships, story progression, and final outcomes, offering high replayability.

Number of romanceable characters: 5 or more

(Separate ending CGs available for over 5 characters)

content_descriptors.notes: The game includes content that may not be suitable for all ages or for viewing at work: partial nudity, depictions of sexual violence (rape, abuse), references to illegal drugs, weapon imagery, violent acts and descriptions, criminal behavior, physical harm, corpses, graphic depictions of violence, and other common mature themes.
